I committed and pushed the slice plan (6dc116db) as a new section, *Large files 2: sysroot.rs, modules.rs, emit/mod.rs*, at the end of `docs/selfhosting-plan.md`. Nothing was built.

**emit/mod.rs is mostly code that must stay Rust**, so, as the brief says, `contracts/mod.rs` is planned in its place. In emit/mod.rs, `with_contracts` runs the Rust analyses. The rest is the driver's entry points, `Build`, the `Emitter`'s calls into Nikaia, and one-line adapters. Only `SourceMap` and some table code in the `EmitState` setup are pure: about 160 lines. That is row E13-1, too small for a slice and not to be briefed.

| Row | What | Rust lines | Converter draft |
| :--- | :--- | ---: | ---: |
| M1 | modules.rs: the ledger merge in `Program::of`, `lost_sync`, `declared_once`, `groups`, `as_promised` | ~380 | 71% |
| S2 | sysroot.rs: `Sysroot` paths, `cpu_levels`, `Package`, the lowered-file cache keys | ~445 | 90% |
| M2 | modules.rs: `with_tests_as_functions`, `names_in` (too small alone, goes with M1) | ~205 | 36% |
| S1 | sysroot.rs: building the text of the lowered package (`shared`, `facade`, `without_bodies`) | ~405 | 44% |
| C1 | contracts/mod.rs: the declared-items loop of `infer_package_noted`, `attribute_values` | ~465 | 45% |
| E13-1 | emit/mod.rs: `SourceMap` and the `EmitState` tables (not briefed) | ~160 | 100% |

- **First two to brief: M1, then S2.** They are in different files and both are above 60%.
  - M1's risk: the ledgers are merged one package at a time, so the Rust callback that infers a ledger is called inside the Nikaia loop.
  - S2's risk: the cache keys hash Rust's debug text of the ledger and build settings. In Nikaia that text differs, so every key changes once, which means one full re-lowering, and must then stay stable from run to run.
- **S1 and C1 wait for converter fixes.** Both drafts are under 60%, which stops the pipeline. S1 needs `.get(range)` on a string, `else if let`, and `Some(..)` inside struct patterns (#886); on the last one the draft also ran `raw_string` and `facade` together on one line. C1 needs `.entry(k).or_default().insert(v)`.
- **A converter mistake for its lane:** it marks every `Ledger` parameter as staying in Rust, although `Ledger` is already defined in Nikaia (`ty.nika`).

**Checks:** this is docs only, so there are no tests. The guard set passed (22 tests), clippy was clean, and `scripts/pre-push-check.sh` passed. Gate: green.

**Disk:** nothing freed (no clone of my own). `target/nikaia-project-tests` is 3.8 GB with 17 GB free. One entry over 100 MB is newer than the brief: `run-bundle/65d964130cc06fb2`, 300 MB. My converter build had changed the converter's `nikaia.contracts` and `nikaia.lock`; I restored both.

The report is written, but it is untracked because the commit script does not add it.
